sections.section_title: DCMIPP Pipex current downsize ratio register (DCMIPP_PxCDSRTIOR)
sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.125 "DCMIPP Pipex current downsize ratio register (DCMIPP_PxCDSRTIOR)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1982.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0xB14 + 0x400 * (x - 1), (x = 1 to 2)
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
The down scale ratio is expressed in unsigned 3.13 format:
ratio = max(int((source / destination) * 8192), 8 * 8192 - 1)
Bits 31:16 VRATIO[15:0]: Current vertical ratio, from 8192 (1x) to 65535 (8x)
Bits 15:0 HRATIO[15:0]: Current horizontal ratio, from 8192 (1x) to 65535 (8x)
